items.title: X post from @oscarpiastri81: Oscar on missing the intensity of a championship fight despite a more relaxed season, via @Raci…
items.title_zh: X 发帖 @oscarpiastri81：Oscar谈尽管赛季更轻松但仍怀念冠军争夺的紧张感，via @Racingnews365：“如果可以，我想每年都参与冠军争夺，但今年也确实轻松了一些。显然，我们并不想处于这个位置，但压力没那么大了。“但你在冠军争夺中感受到的那种压力正是你想要的感觉，因为那意味着你在为你目标中的东西而战。今年我确实怀念那种感觉，它会带来一些额外的紧张感之类的。“但是的，也不是全都……当你不在冠军争夺中时，有些事情会稍微容易一些。”[via @mesandor 和 @ianparkesf1]
items.summary: Oscar on missing the intensity of a championship fight despite a more relaxed season, via @Racingnews365: “I want to be in a championship fight every year if I can be, but also, it's definitely a bit more relaxed this year. Obviously, we're not wanting to be in this position, but there's not quite the same stress. “But that stress that you have in a championship fight is the feeling you want because it means you're fighting for something that is what your goal is. I am missing that feeling this year for sure, and it adds a bit of extra intensity and things like that. “But yeah, it's not all... there are some things that are a little bit easier when you're not in a championship.” [via @mesandor and @ianparkesf1]
items.summary_zh: Oscar谈尽管赛季更轻松但仍怀念冠军争夺的紧张感，via @Racingnews365：“如果可以，我想每年都参与冠军争夺，但今年也确实轻松了一些。显然，我们并不想处于这个位置，但压力没那么大了。“但你在冠军争夺中感受到的那种压力正是你想要的感觉，因为那意味着你在为你目标中的东西而战。今年我确实怀念那种感觉，它会带来一些额外的紧张感之类的。“但是的，也不是全都……当你不在冠军争夺中时，有些事情会稍微容易一些。”[via @mesandor 和 @ianparkesf1]

events.hot_word_en: Oscar on understanding and addressing the car’s difficulties for @Racingnews365: “It was clear at the beginni…

items.title: X post from @oscarpiastri81: Oscar on understanding and addressing the car’s difficulties for @Racingnews365: “It was clear…
items.title_zh: X 发帖 @oscarpiastri81：Oscar谈理解并解决赛车困难，接受@Racingnews365采访：“赛季初就很明显它们会相当不同，但主要是在动力单元方面。赛车本身更小，下压力更少，所以当然它们总会不一样，但我觉得前几场比赛我们真的都在忙于动力单元以及如何把它发挥到极致。“前几场比赛之后，尤其是他们调整了一些规则之后，情况变得稍微正常了一些，那时我们才真正深入研究赛车本身是什么样的。“它开起来并不那么容易，甚至到现在也还是不容易。所以很早我们就意识到这将会很有挑战性。我们花了一段时间才确切理解需要改变什么，然后真正去改变它又很难。“但我们在慢慢取得进展，这就是我们能继续努力做的全部。所以是的，那一直是最主要的事情。我们很早就意识到这辆车有一些难以处理的地方。”[via @mesandor 和 @ianparkesf1]
items.summary: Oscar on understanding and addressing the car’s difficulties for @Racingnews365: “It was clear at the beginning of the season that they were going to be quite different, but mainly from the power unit side of things. The actual cars themselves are smaller, they have less downforce, so of course they're always going to be different, but I think the first few races we were really occupied with the power unit and how to get the most out of that. “After the first few races, and especially after they tweaked some of the rules, it became a bit more normal, and that's when we really dug deep into what the car itself is like. “It wasn't that easy to drive, and it's still not been easy to drive, even now. So, pretty early on we identified that it was going to be challenging. It took us a while to understand exactly what needed to change, and then trying to actually change it is tough. “But we're making progress with it slowly, and that's all we can keep trying to do. So yeah, that's been the biggest thing. We recognized pretty early on that the car had some things that were tricky to manage.” [via @mesandor and @ianparkesf1]
